title: Visible Mysteries and the Gathering of the Cosmic Body
summary: Visible mysteries as signs of the divine going-forth, ending in the gathering inward. T66 expounds the seven goods divine truth works in the soul when it shines, and the seven evils of the night. T67 sets out the two mysteries borne by the daily luminaries — sun and moon as signs of the Lord in his inmost. T68 reads the sun's daily rising and setting as the going-forth that scatters the proprium and the gathering at consummation. T69 describes the five works of love-as-fire in the natural mind. T70 explains how the twelve zodia — the complete circuit of states under self-love — were drawn from the five worlds of darkness. T71 expounds the natural mind shaped as a body with the rational keeping watch over its degrees. T72 traces the chain of inward gathering by which every degree rises into the one above it. T73 unfolds why the one truth wears many names — pearls, icons, robes, element of light, cross of light — and how they all gather back into one likeness at the end.
organizing_principle: Visible mysteries are signs of the divine going-forth: T66-T68 expound sun and moon as the two visible mysteries of the Father in his inmost; T69 expounds the five works of love-as-fire; T70-T71 expound the cosmic body and zodiacal circuit as the structured field of the natural; T72-T73 unfold the gathering inward of every degree and every name into one likeness — the consummation theme implicit in the cosmic body becomes explicit.
